title: Tape Cipher
game_overview: A dark folkloric word puzzle game set inside a cursed cassette tape deck, deciphering tricky grammar and homophones before the ribbon snaps.
winning_condition: Successfully repair and decipher all 20 magnetic tape chapters across escalating frontier grammar and synonym dilemmas.
losing_condition: Accumulate 6 structural tape fractures in a single spool chapter, causing total ribbon desynchronization.

controls.input: Click / Tap on Word Option / On-Screen Key
controls.action: Select a letter or homophone solution (e.g., their / there / they're, its / it's, effect / affect).
Directly type letter guesses for hangman-style missing letter blanks.
Spend magnetic audio flux to reveal a grammatical etymology clue.
Inspect cassette log or rewind the active reel playback.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Tactile Analog Mystery: The atmosphere blends a vintage cassette player with vibrant American folklore storybook art. 2. Progressive Linguistic Mastery: Three difficulty modes (Easy, Medium/SAT Prep, Hard/GRE) featuring vast randomized question pools. 3. Multi-Faceted Language Puzzles: Combines homophone matrices, missing-letter ciphers, and nuanced synonym challenges. 4. Chapter Deciphered Lore: 20 distinct, richly illustrated frontier tall-tale artworks unlocked across all 20 chapters.
sections.summary: Core aesthetic and mechanical pillars guiding player experience.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Synonym Matrix Puzzles: Players identify precise synonyms across varying tonal registers (archaic, literary, and GRE level) to restore degraded tape ribbons. 2. 20 Distinct Story Chapters: Expands from the Coyote Den to the Master Spool Convergence, each with unique narrative epilogues and custom artwork. 3. Shuffled Option Matrices: All homophone and synonym options are dynamically shuffled per question. 4. Live Speed Timer & High Scores: Real-time stopwatch calculates speed bonuses factored into leaderboard records.
sections.summary: 20-chapter campaign, synonym challenge archetype, randomized question banks, dynamic timer bonuses, and persistent records.
